period_boundaries.note: parse_period() only supports YYYY-MM:YYYY-MM calendar-month-start boundaries. Real XAUUSD M1 history begins 2026-04-06 (mid-month); run_backtest()'s own >4-day data-gap guard rejects a 2026-04 period start (~5.9 day gap from 2026-04-01), so 'full' starts 2026-05-01, dropping ~25 days (~17%) of real April history. train/holdout split at 2026-08-01 is the closest month boundary to a 70/30 split of the ~126 real days available May-Sep3: train=May-Jul (92 real days, ~73%), holdout=Aug1-Sep3 (34 real days, ~27%); contiguous, non-overlapping, no lookahead leakage.
